title: Surreal Psyche Cascade
description: A surreal vertical composition features three layered female figures against a desert landscape. At the bottom, a woman in an orange wide-brimmed hat looks left; above her floats a child's head with a large central eye on its forehead, painted with colorful patches and dripping blue liquid; the top figure is a green-skinned woman in profile whose head dissolves into a cosmic tree with stars and a teddy bear floating beside her.
prompt: Surreal symbolic artwork showing three layered female figures in a desert canyon under a large pale moon. Bottom is a woman with long hair wearing a bright orange wide-brimmed hat looking left. Above her floats a child's head with big blue eyes, colorful paint splotches, a large realistic eye on the forehead, and blue liquid dripping from the chin. Higher up is a green-skinned woman in profile whose head opens into a purple cosmic tree with stars and branches, a teddy bear floating nearby, water splashing between the layers, in a vibrant dreamlike style with smooth digital painting textures.
